note: First-pass numbers chosen by the assistant on 2026-11-14. None has been tuned with players. Version 3: the second decision is a call to Trauma Team (ids still say 'refer'); a call on a steady patient now costs the call-out (false_call). Agent limits were raised for typed and spoken conversation: 16 patient-model calls per visit, a 4 s wait, replies asked to stay within 110 characters and shown up to 220 (two pages of the strip); the proxy must hold the same numbers. Push-to-talk (agent.voice): a clip is at most 10 s, 24 clips per visit, 7 s to wait for its words; quieter than silence_peak is not sent. Version 4 (2026-11-15, after the student's eleven notes): the flat rent became an hourly line (line.per_hour: one visit is one hour, the meter is read after each, and the last reading decides the night); a patient whose patience reaches 0 waits patience.leave_ms and then leaves unpaid and unbilled (outcome gave_up); the counter glass takes attack.glass blows per shift, attack.blow_at places them inside window_ms, and with less glass left the patient comes through sooner, never sooner than attack.min_window_ms. Version 5 (2026-11-16, after the student's notes on the screen and the glass): between patients the doctor can pay attack.repair_cost credits for one layer of the counter glass. It takes one more blow, and an empty frame has a pane again. The money leaves the till at once and the meter counts it at every later reading. No other number changed. Version 6 (2026-11-17, after the student's notes on clarity, CALM, sudden rage and the new story: the doctor, fired by Kessler and in debt, fronts a Lantern street clinic and passes contraband chrome): contacts (the night's couriers, data/contacts.json) pay contacts.pay for a drop and a wrong code costs contacts.wrong_cost patience; the line doubles to 240 an hour, so right calls alone (1140) no longer hold it and at least one drop is needed; CALM is a calm-patch from the drawer that costs reassure.cost credits a use; a drifting patient may snap mid-exam (snap: no chance for the first snap.grace actions, then snap.step more per action, up to snap.max) and any patient may flare once a visit (flare: a shout and a hand on the glass, no attack, evidence for TEMPER only). Neither happens on the training visit. Every other number is unchanged.

arrivals.note: Added 2026-11-15: shift_order is who comes in; each shift draws the order from its seed. The first shift of a session opens with a steady patient. --authored-order keeps the listed order (tests and captures).

line.note: What Harrow Credit's meter wants in the till at each hourly reading: hour n needs n x per_hour. Five hours make 1200. The five fees and two hand-overs of a night of right calls make 1140, so the night is held only with at least one contact's drop (contacts.pay). The readings before the last are warnings; the last one decides the night.

patience.note: At 0 the patient gives an ultimatum and leaves after this long unless the player decides or reassures. 0 makes them leave at once.

reassure.note: CALM: a calm-patch from the drawer. Each use gives gain patience back, clears refusals for a retry, and takes cost credits off the till (the till may go below zero). uses per visit.

contacts.note: per_night: how many of the night's visitors are couriers, each for a different visitor (the training night always puts the first visitor on the list). pay: what a drop puts in the till. wrong_cost: the patience a wrong code costs, whoever hears it. A code needs at least wrong_cost patience left to be said, right or wrong, so a patient on the way out cannot be sounded for free.

snap.note: Only a drifting patient snaps. Each action (a tool, a question, pressure, CALM, a code, the player's own words; looking is free and does not count) is rolled once: the chance is (actions - grace) x step, never above max. A roll that comes up fires after delay_min_ms to delay_max_ms, inside whatever the action is doing, and the attack starts after lead_ms instead of the usual beat. It is the same attack as any other: the red bar, the shutter, the glass. Caught, it counts as a right call.

flare.note: Anyone may flare, at most once a visit, from the action after grace on: a shout and a hand slammed on the glass. It is never an attack: no red bar, nothing to stop, nothing scored. Its note goes on the TEMPER line and agrees with the case (face and voice together, or not). A snap that comes up wins over a flare.

attack.note: blow_at: when each blow lands on the glass, as a share of window_ms. A blow that lands before the shutter is down costs one of the glass points. With g points left only g blows land and the patient comes through at the time of the next one (1800, 1440, 990 ms, then min_window_ms). repair_cost: what one point costs to put back, between patients; 0 switches repairs off. At 40 a whole pane (three layers) costs 120, half an hour of the line at 240 an hour.

titles_note: The first entry that fits is used. min_correct counts right calls (out of five). max_injuries is optional. line_held, where an entry has it, must equal the night's last meter reading: a night that ended under the line is THE CUT whatever else went right, and a night that hurt you is not given a title that says it went well.

titles.title: THE CUT
titles.text: Under the line at closing. Harrow Credit sends two quiet people to collect on the debt. They start with the hands.

titles.title: STEADY HANDS
titles.text: Five patients, five right calls. The sheet goes back on its nail. You open again tomorrow.

titles.title: RIGHT THE HARD WAY
titles.text: Every call was right, and one of them still reached you. Reading people is half the job. The shutter is the other half.

titles.title: A GOOD NIGHT'S WORK
titles.text: One visit went wrong. Most nights are like that. The rest went the way they should.

titles.title: OPEN, BARELY
titles.text: You were right more often than not. In this trade that is not the same as safe.

titles.title: ON NOTICE
titles.text: The line held, and that is the kindest thing to say. The Lanterns noticed the rest. The sheet was on the wall the whole time.

line_text.held: Meter: OVER THE LINE. The debt waits another night.
line_text.short: Meter: UNDER THE LINE. The debt is called in.
